desc: 冷灰白配叶绿详情页，白石圆台与六边形框，尖顶木屋十一镜从首屏到收口

name: 木质尖顶可拆洗四季猫狗屋款

shots.intent: 首屏用白石圆台与柔白圆盘把尖顶木屋立成一件小家具，一眼看清它是硬质宠物屋而不是软垫窝
shots.textZone: 顶部叶绿胶囊 kicker 位、其下两行堆叠主标题带与短下划线、标题下一行副标题位

shots.intent: 用左侧被裁切放大的屋体压住画面、右侧四条勾选短标签逐条对上买家最担心的四个问题，把痛点转成主张
shots.textZone: 顶部两行主标题带与发丝横线，右栏四枚勾选图标各配一行短标签位

shots.intent: 把源图六枚重复的星形占位换成一张白卡里的三乘二结构矩阵，让屋体、屋面、门口三处构造各有一条可扫读的说明
shots.textZone: 卡上方两行主标题带与绿色下划线圆点，卡内六格各一行短标签与一行拉丁小字位

shots.intent: 整屋居中配八条发丝引线短标签，把四季通用与可拆洗这两条主利益一次讲完而不堆形容词
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与叶绿胶囊位，产品四周八条引线短标签位

shots.intent: 两面同光同裁的六边形窗格分别对准坡屋面与立板墙身，把两处构造差异讲成看得见的对照而不是口头条款
shots.textZone: 两块六边形窗格各配一行面别标签与一行短说明位，顶部两行主标题带

shots.intent: 表面线侧剖微距配一枚无字硬币做真实比例尺，让瓦片搭接与板缝厚度不靠形容词成立
shots.textZone: 上部两行主标题带与其下一行短说明位

shots.intent: 把木屋放进真实客厅墙角，一只被裁切的狗坐在门口外，证明它是家里立得住的一件宠物家具
shots.textZone: 左下两行主标题带与短下划线，其下一行短适用标签位

shots.intent: 编号三格讲清怎么让宠物用起这间木屋，把使用疑问前置解决以降低退货与咨询成本
shots.textZone: 三格上方两行主标题带，三枚编号圆与每格下方一行短步骤标签位

shots.intent: 源图三张一模一样的白底卡换成同一屋体三个角度的选择卡，让买家看清侧面与背面再决定
shots.textZone: 顶部两行主标题带，三条绿色脚栏各一行角度标签位

shots.intent: 把源图混着口号与会员贴片的收尾区换成一张可核对的字段卡，用结构化信息承接最后顾虑
shots.textZone: 右栏五行字段标签与占位值，卡片上方两行主标题带与其下一行拉丁 kicker 位

shots.intent: 收口用一枚大号六边形框立住整屋、竖排主张配一个低摩擦按钮，替换源图的会员二维码贴片
shots.textZone: 右上竖排主标题位、下格下方一行短说明位、右下圆角胶囊按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: flat cool off-white panels #EDEEF0 joined by one pale blue-grey gradient band #DCE3EC, a large soft white disc #FFFFFF sitting behind the product as the single depth device, and clean white #FFFFFF rounded cards holding the product; two real indoor screens on a pale micro-cement floor #E4E6E8 carry the lifestyle beats; one background treatment per screen, never a fourth language, never a warm wood-plank interior
style.direction: cool grey leaf-green rigid pet-house detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight 2px line pictograms in #2D2D2D, green circular check glyphs outlined in #57B94A, one recurring hexagon outline frame in #57B94A as the section device, numbered circles for sequenced steps; flat vector only, no 3D, no gloss, no sparkle, one weight everywhere
style.lightingSystem: even cool studio key at 6000K from the upper left with a soft 6500K fill, low contrast, matte controlled highlights running along the plank edges and the shingle lips with no specular blowout, and always a real contact shadow under the base so a rigid house reads its own weight and never floats; the two indoor screens use north-window daylight at 5600K with soft shadows falling to the right
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool grey-and-leaf-green rigid pet-house ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool off-white panel #EDEEF0, pale blue-grey gradient band #DCE3EC, white marble pedestal and card surfaces #FFFFFF, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D and one leaf-green accent #57B94A; neutral studio tone; modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese and Latin with one headline weight per screen, stacked two-line headline 34-48pt in #2D2D2D paired with a short leaf-green underline bar and one dot in #57B94A, one capsule pill kicker in #FFFFFF on #57B94A at 14-16pt, a letter-spaced Latin kicker 11-13pt in #9A9A9A at most once per screen, hairline leader rules in #B9BDC4, all copy as 「」 placeholders; background system alternating flat cool off-white panels #EDEEF0 with one pale blue-grey gradient band #DCE3EC, a large soft white disc behind the product as the only depth device and clean white #FFFFFF rounded cards, plus two real indoor screens on a pale micro-cement floor #E4E6E8, one treatment per screen; even cool studio key at 6000K from the upper left with a soft 6500K fill, low contrast, matte controlled highlights along the plank edges and shingle lips, no specular blowout, and always a real contact shadow under the base so the rigid house never floats; surfaces of matte white marble with faint grey veining, pale cool-grey sweep and pale micro-cement floor with grain and board joints kept as real relief and never plastic-smoothed; infographic components limited to thin single-weight 2px line pictograms, green circular check glyphs, one recurring hexagon outline frame in #57B94A and numbered circles, 20px rounded card corners, flat vector only; the house held at constant plank width and board count, roof pitch, shingle row count, scalloped tab row and doorway proportion across screens, the plaque above the opening left blank and never printed, the opening never fitted with a door, no added window or hinge; any animal cropped or turned away so no individual identity reads; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no price or HOT burst badge, no QR code or membership patch, no repeated identical icon labels, no glossy 3D icons.
noDrift: no price, HOT badge or flame burst overlay
no QR code, membership or free-store patch
no repeated identical label under several icons
no invented dimension, weight, age, breed, material, certification or import claim
no added door, window, hinge, handle or raised roof panel
no text, letter or mark rendered on the blank plaque
no glossy 3D icons, sparkle, steam or snowflake effects
style.presentationRules: the house keeps a constant plank width and board count, roof pitch, shingle row count, scalloped tab row and doorway proportion across every screen; front 3/4 is the anchor angle and a clean 90-degree side profile is used only once; the blank plaque above the opening always stays unprinted and never carries a word, letter or mark; the opening is never fitted with a door and no window, hinge or extra panel is introduced; photo card corners fixed at 20px; the product always grounded by its own contact shadow; any animal cropped or turned away so no individual reads as identifiable
style.surfaceSystem: matte white marble round pedestal with faint grey veining, pale cool-grey sweep #EDEEF0, pale blue-grey band #DCE3EC, and a pale micro-cement floor #E4E6E8 inside the lifestyle frames; grain, board joints and shingle lapping always readable as real relief, never smoothed into plastic
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for both Chinese and Latin, one headline weight per screen; stacked two-line Chinese headline 34-48pt in #2D2D2D paired with a short leaf-green underline bar and a single dot in #57B94A, one capsule pill kicker reading #FFFFFF on #57B94A at 14-16pt, a letter-spaced Latin kicker 11-13pt in #9A9A9A used at most once per screen, hairline leader rules in #B9BDC4, all rendered copy carried as 「」 placeholders
